dpfCleaningService.title: What are DPFs?
dpfCleaningService.description: Diesel particulate filters (DPFs) are an essential component of modern diesel engines. They help reduce harmful emissions and ensure that the engine runs efficiently. However, over time, these filters can become clogged with soot and other particles, reducing their effectiveness and potentially causing damage to the engine. In this article, we will discuss the importance of cleaning DPFs and the services offered by Aros Filter AB.

items.0: Remove the DPF from your car
items.1: We conduct a pre-clean air flow test to verify there is a blockage and note the reading.
items.2: We then use our DPF cleaning solution and soak the DPF
items.3: We then place the DPF on the machine and use high-pressured air and water to force all the carbon, soot & ash from the filter until only clean water runs freely.
items.4: We then connect the freshly cleaned DPF to a blower and dry the filter.
items.5: Finally, we carry out a post-clean air flow test to ensure the blockage has been removed and note the reading.
items.6: We would always recommend that a carbon clean is carried out in conjunction with the DPF clean. This will clear any carbon build-up upstream of the DPF.

whyCleaning.title: Why clean your DPF?
whyCleaning.description: Cleaning diesel particulate filters is crucial for maintaining the engine’s performance and reducing harmful emissions. When a DPF becomes clogged, the engine may experience reduced power, increased fuel consumption, and potential engine damage. Furthermore, a clogged DPF can cause the engine to produce higher levels of harmful pollutants, such as nitrogen oxides (NOx) and particulate matter (PM).

whatCausesDpfBlockage.title: What causes a dpf blockage?
whatCausesDpfBlockage.description: Short journeys at low speeds are the main cause of blocked diesel particulate filters.Other things that are bad for DPFs include poor servicing, clogged EGR valve & excessive carbon build-up.

howDoIKnowitNeedsCleaning.title: How do I know if my DPF needs cleaning?

list.title: Several signs indicate that your DPF may need cleaning:

items.0: Warning Light: Most modern vehicles are equipped with a DPF warning light that illuminates when the filter is becoming clogged
items.1: Reduced Engine Performance: If you experience a noticeable drop in power or acceleration, it may be a sign of a blocked DPF
items.2: Increased Fuel Consumption: A clogged DPF can lead to decreased fuel efficiency, resulting in more frequent refuelling
items.3: Exhaust Smoke: Dark smoke emitting from the exhaust, especially during acceleration, may indicate a clogged DPF.

howDoIKnowitNeedsCleaning.descriptionAfter: If you notice any of these signs, it’s essential to have your DPF inspected and cleaned promptly.
